fields: h, intro, cols [item, typical, note], rows [{p, v, m, link, link_label, at}]. Look-only: rows[].at names the connection a row is keyed to: limit | footprint | utilities | joint | tag | tiein | isolation (default: that order, row by row); a row whose at is unknown or "none" gets no node. Values written "a · b" break into lines. fold and fold_noun are not read: every row shows (S7, the drawing points at every row).
best_for: LimitPlan shows what a site provides before the package arrives as a battery-limits plan: an isometric drawing of the package footprint inside a dashed battery-limit line, with a numbered square node on each connection keyed to the row of the same number beside it.
